result.title: EgoWitness: Benchmarking Instance-Level Spatial Memory and Reasoning in Egocentric Video Streams
result.comment: 43 pages, including supplementary material. Zhengru Fang and Zehao Liu contributed equally. Project page: https://egowitness.github.io/ ; Code: https://github.com/egowitness/EgoWitness
result.summary: Recalling where and when an object was last seen and who saw it requires recognizing it across days and people. Existing long-video benchmarks focus on events, object categories, or relative locations, leaving instance-level spatial memory largely untested in multimodal models. To address this gap, we present EgoWitness, a benchmark for instance-level spatial memory and reasoning in egocentric video. Its 8,453 human-verified questions span approximately 324 hours of week-long and short-horizon recordings and test seven abilities, from recognizing an object or room to recalling who saw it and reasoning about room visits. Over one million reviewed masks of 34 registered landmarks and 21 movable-object labels are linked through room timelines. Among twelve direct vision-language models (VLMs), open-weight models reach at most 46.97% accuracy, and none exceeds 35% on identifying who saw an object last. We therefore propose EgoClue, a spatial-memory agent that retrieves candidate intervals, verifies instance identity, and computes spatial and temporal relations with five tools. Two-stage training with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises its 4B controller from 23.64% to 72.65% accuracy on 1,320 held-out questions. Evidence-trace synthesis matches the best direct VLM at 74.85% on week-long questions and achieves 80.56% in environments excluded from training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 EgoWitness，一个面向第一视角视频的实例级空间记忆与推理基准（约 324 小时录制、8,453 个经人工校验问题，覆盖七类能力），并给出 EgoClue 空间记忆 agent：用五个工具检索候选时段、核验实例身份、计算时空关系，经 SFT 加 GRPO 将 4B 控制器从 23.64% 提升到 72.65%。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作直接诊断多模态模型能否保留并调用跨时段、跨人物的视觉实例证据，可作为视觉证据筛选与检索式推理的对照；其外部工具加证据轨迹的做法也可能提供核查线索，用来比较它与内部 latent 状态在证据获取和计算分配上的差别。
